newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Mondragon unit seeks mediation on row.
newsitem.headline: Mondragon unit seeks mediation on row.

text.p: A unit of Mondragon International Philippines Inc and state-run Clark Development Corp said on Tuesday they have sought mediation to settle a dispute over rentals for a Mondragon resort.
CDC manages the Clark Special Economic Zone in the northern Luzon island where Mondragon Leisure and Resorts Corp operates a hotel, golf and country club and a casino.
In a joint statement, Mondragon Leisure president Jose Antonio Gonzalez and CDC president Romeo David said former Trade and Industry Secretary Rizalino Navarro would act as mediator.
It did not give details of the dispute.
